description: This file is the entry point of a React web application. It sets up rendering of the main App component into the DOM, using ReactDOM's createRoot method for rendering and wrapping the application in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering into the DOM element with the specified ID.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root element.
